The Godot SDK's UI kit, in GDScript, for desktop, phones, tablets, the Steam Deck and TVs. One call
gates a game and runs every screen the license needs: the boot, Activate with the key field, the
sign-in form, offline activation, Replace a device, the blocking states with their fixes, offline
grace, the update prompt and the settings. Every screen is also a scene of its own, and every
state comes from headless view models that run the shared
[UI state matrix](/docs/reference/corpus/), so a game that draws its own menus gets the same
states, copy and actions. The rest of the Godot SDK is on the [Godot](/docs/build/sdks/godot/) page.

<KitFacts kit="godot" />

## Install

The kit is part of the addon at `res://addons/polaris_key/`, installed from Polaris Key's Godot
feed ([Installing the SDKs from the feeds](/docs/build/install-from-feeds/)). It runs on Godot 4.4
and later, and bundles Rubik and JetBrains Mono (both OFL).

## The one-line flow

```gdscript
await PolarisKey.boot()
```

`boot()` reads `res://polaris_key.tres`, syncs, gates on the license and checks for an update on
the `PKeyBoot` screen, and returns once the player is through. A stop keeps its card on screen
with Try again. The settings open over the game in one line too, and close with Close, Escape or
a pad's B:

```gdscript
PKeySettingsPanel.open(self)
```

## Piecemeal

Each screen is a `Control` scene a game can place itself: `PKeyGateView`, `PKeyActivationPanel`,
`PKeySignInDialog`, `PKeyOfflineDialog`, `PKeyUpdatePrompt`, `PKeyStatusBanner`,
`PKeySettingsPanel` and `PKeyEntitlementBadge`. A scene lays itself out for its window: two panes
on a wide landscape panel, one column at 4:3, and on a phone the page full-bleed with the product
at the top and the actions docked at the bottom, the primary on top. A scene a game's own menu
holds draws no card of its own.

## Headless

The view models are in `addons/polaris_key/ui/model/`. Each is a pure function of one input
Dictionary and answers the state, the catalog copy keys, the actions and the design decisions
(the one primary, what takes focus, which links and QR codes may show):

```gdscript
const Models := preload("res://addons/polaris_key/ui/model/models.gd")

var view := Models.view_of("PolarisKeyGate", {"gate": {"status": "revoked"}})
# view["state"] == "blocked"
```

`sign_in_session.gd` is the sign-in form's state machine over the SDK's sign-in primitives, and
`copy_format.gd` formats a copy key in the player's locale.

## Theming

The Polaris Key look is the default, dark, in the product's accent; `ui_branding = "none"`
follows the game's own theme. The options are on `PKeyOptions` (`ui_brand_scheme`, `ui_accent`,
`ui_theme`, `ui_density`, `ui_product_name`, `ui_product_icon`); the fields are on
[Theming](/docs/build/ui/theming/). `ui_reduce_motion` and `ui_reduce_transparency` follow the
system's settings by default (`auto`, from Godot 4.5) and can be forced `on` or `off`.

## Localisation

The kit's copy is generated as gettext tables in `addons/polaris_key/ui/locale/`, one per launch
locale. `PKeyUiCopy.overrides` renames any string without forking a scene.

## Sample

`sdks/godot/examples/minimal/` boots, reads the license and the config, opens the settings and
buys a store item, in one script.
